description: This file contains functions for upgrading eMMC storage on OpenWrt devices, including handling different upgrade formats (tar, fit), copying configuration, and setting up environment variables based on device specifics.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles updating eMMC with tarball images, including kernel and root filesystem.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles updating eMMC with fit images.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup data to the appropriate eMMC partition.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to determine upgrade type and invoke the corresponding upgrade function.
